items.exampleEn: The critics were not very complimentary about the new film.
items.exampleZh: 影評人對這部新電影的評價不太好。

items.exampleEn: Many parents feel apprehensive when their children start driving.
items.exampleZh: 孩子開始開車時，很多父母都會感到憂心。

items.exampleEn: The cat became hostile when the new dog arrived.
items.exampleZh: 新的狗來了以後，那隻貓變得很有敵意。
items.glossZh: 敵意的、不友善的；惡劣的

items.exampleEn: She does voluntary work at the animal shelter on weekends.
items.exampleZh: 她週末在動物收容所做志工。

items.exampleEn: Winning the award gave his ego a big boost.
items.exampleZh: 得獎讓他的自尊心大大提升。

items.exampleEn: There was open hostility between the two teams' fans.
items.exampleZh: 兩隊的球迷之間公開地互相敵視。

items.exampleEn: Cats are often wary of strangers.
items.exampleZh: 貓常常對陌生人保持警戒。

items.exampleEn: She was naive about how much it costs to run a small cafe.
items.exampleZh: 她把經營一家小咖啡館要花多少錢想得太天真了。

items.sentenceEn: The hotel offers complimentary coffee in the lobby every morning.
items.sentenceZh: 這家飯店每天早上在大廳提供免費咖啡。

items.audioEn: Mina was apprehensive about her first day at the new job.
items.audioZh: Mina 對新工作的第一天感到很不安。
items.questionZh: Mina 對新工作第一天有什麼感覺？
options: She did not care at all.

items.sentenceEn: Be wary of anyone who promises easy money.
items.sentenceZh: 要提防那些保證輕鬆賺錢的人。

items.sentenceEn: Joining the club after school is completely voluntary.
items.sentenceZh: 放學後參加社團完全是自願的。

items.stemEn: The crowd was ____ at first, but the singer soon won them over.
items.stemZh: 觀眾一開始充滿敵意，但那位歌手很快就贏得了他們的心。

items.stemEn: She felt ____ before the big job interview.
items.stemZh: 那場重要的工作面試之前，她感到很不安。

items.passageEn: When a new family moved in next door, Mr. Wang was wary of them. Their dog barked at night, and he thought they were hostile because they did not greet him. His wife told him he was being unfair, but his ego made it hard to admit he might be wrong. Then one day, the new neighbors brought over a cake and a complimentary note about his beautiful garden. Mr. Wang realized that the hostility had existed only in his own mind. He apologized, and now the two families have a warm rapport.
items.passageZh: 隔壁搬來新的一家人時，王先生對他們很有戒心。他們的狗晚上會叫，他又覺得他們不跟他打招呼，是對他不友善。他太太說他這樣不公平，但他的自尊心讓他很難承認自己可能錯了。後來有一天，新鄰居送來一個蛋糕，還附上一張稱讚他花園很漂亮的字條。王先生這才明白，那份敵意只存在他自己的心裡。他道了歉，現在兩家人相處得很融洽。

questions.questionZh: 王先生一開始為什麼覺得鄰居不友善？
新鄰居後來帶了什麼過來？
options: 一籃自己種的新鮮水果

items.promptZh: 相信陌生人說的每一句話，未免太天真了。
referenceEn: It is naive to believe everything a stranger says.
Believing every word a stranger says is too naive.
rubricZh: naive 表示「天真的」（例如 It is naive to…、is too naive 等）
「每一句話」可寫，例如 everything、every word 等

items.promptZh: 這家航空公司提供乘客免費的耳機。
referenceEn: This airline offers passengers complimentary headphones.
The airline gives its passengers complimentary headphones.
rubricZh: 「免費的」用 complimentary（例如 complimentary headphones 等）

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：干擾項重複出現且一眼可排除：oval 在本課 q13、q14 都出現，並與 u08、u09 多課重複
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: oval 移除：q13 改為 complimentary、voluntary、enthusiastic；q14 改為 ego 與 accustomed、versatile（形容詞，放得進 felt ____ 但語意不通），兩題不共用干擾項；不用 wary

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：干擾項重複出現且一眼可排除：oval 同課重複；ego 為名詞，與形容詞空格詞性不同
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 同上；ego 為名詞，另兩個干擾項為形容詞、放得進空格

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：疑似：英文寫 he thought they were hostile because they did not greet him，覺得不友善的原因只有「沒打招呼」；正解選項把「狗晚上會叫」也列為原因，略超出原文
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 正解改為「他們沒有跟他打招呼」（原文只說因為沒打招呼而覺得不友善）；干擾項「他們把車停在他家門口」改短為「車停在他家門口」以維持長度名次；審題員原選的正是此題正解，判題改以修正後的正解文字對應

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：自查（執行長釋義原則）：hostile 例句「The desert is a hostile place for most plants.」示範的是次要義，第一義應為最常用義「敵意的、不友善的」
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 例句改寫為「The cat became hostile when the new dog arrived.」示範第一義；釋義為「敵意的、不友善的；惡劣的」

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長 c1b2 裁示修正：評分要點有「可寫 X 等」沒有「例如」、「常用 X」或寫死位置、時態（§11.23）
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 依執行長 c1b2 裁示（第 1 批一併改）統一改成「例如…等」或「X 的用法，例如…等」：naive 表示「天真的」（例如 It is naive to…、is too naive 等）／「每一句話」可寫，例如 everything、every word 等

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長 c1b2 裁示修正：評分要點有「可寫 X 等」沒有「例如」、「常用 X」或寫死位置、時態（§11.23）
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 依執行長 c1b2 裁示（第 1 批一併改）統一改成「例如…等」或「X 的用法，例如…等」：complimentary 可表示「免費贈送的」或「讚美的」（例如 a complimentary breakfast 等）／時態配合內容（例如 gave、made 等）

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 創辦人裁示：造句改翻譯：造句題（complimentary）原位換成翻譯題，沿用題 id c1-u10-l01-q17；目標字沿用 complimentary
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 改為 translate：promptZh「這家航空公司提供乘客免費的耳機。」、hintWords ["complimentary"]、referenceEn ["This airline offers passengers complimentary headphones.","The airline gives its passengers complimentary headphones."]、rubricZh ["「免費的」用 complimentary（例如 complimentary headphones 等）","「提供」可寫，例如 offers、gives、provides 等"]（原 makeSentence：instructionZh「用 complimentary 造一個句子，說說你得到過的免費招待或別人給你的讚美。」、referenceEn ["The hotel gave me a complimentary breakfast on my birthday.","My boss made some complimentary remarks about my report."]）
